info.title: Tangent.Cli
info.description: dotnet tangent: check, lint, diff, graph, init, serve.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Architectural conformance for .NET. Contracts live in .tangent/*.tan.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Never emit ANSI colour. NO_COLOR and a redirected stdout do the same. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Write MSBuild and fix diagnostics to standard error. [default: False]

commands.name: init
commands.description: Scaffold a .tangent folder from the solution's projects.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing .tangent folder. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A .sln, .slnx or .csproj file, or a directory holding exactly one of them. Defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Parse and bind the .tan files; resolve the type names they mention.

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat warnings, including TNG1020, as errors. [default: False]

options.name: --dump-ir
options.description: Print the bound model as JSON. [default: False]

options.name: --dump-ast
options.description: Print the tokens and AST of every .tan file. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A .sln, .slnx or .csproj file, or a directory holding exactly one of them. Defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Run every contract over the solution and report what breaks.

options.name: --sarif
options.description: Write a SARIF 2.1.0 log here.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the JSON report here.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: The lowest severity that fails the command. Default: error, so warnings alone still exit 0. [default: error]

options.name: --show-ignored
options.description: List the violations that an ignore suppressed (TNG9000). [default: False]

options.name: --project
options.description: Only this project. Repeat the option for several.

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat warnings as errors. [default: False]

options.name: --explain
options.description: Follow each violation with the rule text, where it is declared, and the offending line. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A .sln, .slnx or .csproj file, or a directory holding exactly one of them. Defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Show the mechanical fixes as a unified diff.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write the fixes to disk instead of only printing them. [default: False]

options.name: --project
options.description: Only this project. Repeat the option for several.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A .sln, .slnx or .csproj file, or a directory holding exactly one of them. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --output
options.description: Where to write the graph. Default: <solution>/tangent.graph.json.

options.name: --include-unbound
options.description: Add types that no contract binds, so the graph shows the whole solution. [default: False]

options.name: --include-source
options.description: Embed code around each violation, the .tan files and the solution root (for editor links). [default: False]

options.name: --project
options.description: Only this project. Repeat the option for several.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A .sln, .slnx or .csproj file, or a directory holding exactly one of them. Defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run the .tan language server on stdio.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: The folder the server treats as the workspace root.
